subtitle: IoT Basics
courseType:
(Provided by all courses)

educationalGoal: To systematically understand the basic technologies that constitute IoT systems. Understand the application examples of IoT systems. To be able to make proposals on how to use IoT systems to solve actual problems.
advice: In this course, students will learn about the basic technologies that make up IoT systems in a systematic way, while learning how IoT can be used in any field. -IoT system configuration and construction techniques (IoT system architecture, IoT service platform) -Sensor/actuator technologies and communication methods (Sensor/actuator technologies and communication methods (IoT devices, networks, LPWA, protocols) -IoT data utilization technology (IoT data utilization technology (Big data analysis technology, application examples) -IoT information security countermeasure technology (Threats and vulnerabilities, security countermeasure technologies, information security standards and legal systems) -Prototyping technology for IoT systems (Prototyping applications)
requiredKnowledge: Basic computer literacy (Windows/Office operation, typing, etc.).

activityGoals.body: To be able to explain the basic technologies that make up an IoT system.
To be able to explain the application examples of IoT systems.
To be able to make proposals for the use of IoT systems to solve actual problems.
